chart_references: New research by Franklin Noll of the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City finds that nearly half of all stablecoins play the role of crypto-trading assets. Less than 1% of stablecoins in circulation are used for payments. Boston Consulting Group and Allium, a blockchain-data firm, arrive at a similar figure looking at annual transaction values using stablecoins. As crypto enters one of its periodic winters amid a broader risk-off mood provoked by Mr Trump’s warmongering on trade, Iran and the Fed (which he wants to lower interest rates), stablecoins feel the chill.

extraction.title: Buttonwood
extraction.subtitle: The stablecoin market has got too stable Rapid growth in dollar-backed crypto has stalled
extraction.summary: The stablecoin market has stagnated after initial growth, facing regulatory challenges and soft demand. Despite predictions of significant growth, the market's value has remained stable, raising concerns among banks about potential impacts on deposits and lending.
